description: October 25 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 1, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 25 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the first decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: The October 25 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: One degree into Scorpio, the 25th of October doubles Pluto, ruler of both sign and decan, and pairs it with 7, numerology's most introspective number. The combined reading is unusually deep: a person drawn to mysteries, psychology and whatever lies beneath the surface. Privacy matters here, and trust is traditionally earned slowly, then given completely.

Astronomically, October 25 puts the Sun near 1° Scorpio in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Pluto. Pluto rules Scorpio in modern astrology and also governs its first decan, so late October and the first days of November hold the sign in concentrated form. This decan is traditionally associated with intensity, privacy and a capacity to go deep into whatever it touches, whether a relationship, a mystery or a personal reinvention. Trust tends to be slow and, once given, complete. Doubled Pluto can bring a strong will and a reluctance to show vulnerability. Natives often find their power in honest transformation: releasing what no longer fits rather than guarding it out of habit.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for October 25
paragraphs: Born on the 25th, your compound 2 + 5 reduces to 7. The 2's intuition and the 5's curiosity come together in the 7's reflective, analytical temperament. People born on the 25th are frequently described as perceptive, observant and drawn to understanding how things and people really work. They may test ideas through experience before trusting them. In its secondary role, the 25 is traditionally linked with a strong inner voice and a need for quiet time to process what they have gathered. Their insight often becomes valuable to others once they decide to share it.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an October 25 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous October 25 birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 25 is the 298th day of the year (299th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Sagittarius, is usually complete within 29 days, by November 23.

By October 25 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an October 25 birthday are Katy Perry (1984), Georges Bizet (1838) and Évariste Galois (1811).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 25?
faq.answer: October 25 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 25?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 25 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 25th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 25?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by October 25, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 25?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on October 25 include Katy Perry (1984), Georges Bizet (1838) and Évariste Galois (1811). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
